meta.source: Bibliotheca Anonoma '4chan/History' timeline (wiki.bibanon.org/4chan/History): 2003-mid-2012 from page fetch, 2013-2026 from full timeline+citations wiki source provided by user; 2003-2004 cross-checked against archived 4chan.net news page and moot's Something Awful posts. Compiled 2026-08-08, extended 2026-08-12
meta.date_semantics: ISO dates, US Eastern as reported by 4chan news posts. Truncated dates (YYYY or YYYY-MM) indicate precision, not the 1st of the period.

confidence.cited: event and date come from the Bibanon wiki or better; per-entry 'confidence' preserves the old grading: A = dated news post / primary source, B = wiki-dated but sourcing indirect or uninspected, C = approximate / bracketed between sightings
confidence.citation_needed: from general knowledge only; no date field — era hints live in notes as 'reportedly ~YYYY'. Do not use for validation until promoted with a wiki or primary-source date

notes: type is 'created' or 'removed'; a slug can appear multiple times across incarnations (see name field)
/tl/ (Torrents/Loli, 2004-12) was hosted off-site on not4chan.org and is excluded
2004-12-24 textboards on dis.4chan.org (/pol/, /vip/, /sci/, /prog/, etc.) are a separate system and excluded; collide with later imageboard slugs if any archive ingested textboard dumps
/jp/ renamed Japan/General -> Otaku Culture 2010-02-20 (no created/removed event)

Server-side data wipes on 2003-10-29 ('everything had to be pruned') and 2003-11-02 (all SQL tables dropped, PRUNED news post) mean no database-derived archive can contain genuine posts predating 2003-11-02; earlier content exists only as external saves
oekaki.4chan.net went down in the late-Oct 2003 server migration and was still offline as of the 10/29/03 news post ('The oekaki board isn't up, I'll try to get that back in a few days')

2025-04-25 relaunch day: threads were erratically moved across boards for hours (/a/ catalog to /g/, /lgbt/ and /po/ threads to /tv/, threads to /test/) before being moved back — archives capturing that window may show posts under the wrong board
hidden boards exist that never appear on the boardlist (/test/, post-2021 /asp/, /j/ referenced in 2025) — presence of a slug in an archive does not imply public listing

citations: each cited event lists citation ids resolvable in the top-level citations array. Entries with only a 'wiki-YYYY' id are stated in the wiki timeline without a captured external link; 'primary-*' ids are primary sources found during this session. URL citations were auto-extracted from the wiki's ref blocks adjacent to each event (capped at 6 per event) — labels/urls not individually verified.

site_outages.note: server migration outage; start fuzzy (~10-16 crash then move to United Colo ~10-21), end from HOORAY news post 10/29 ('went back up a few hours ago')
April Fools 2025 'Department of 4chan Efficiency': posting progressively blocked on most boards through the day (only /b/ /bant/ /f/ /r9k/ /s4s/ /trash/ /vip/ left open); partial, not a full outage
post-hack outage, '10 days and 15 hours', site back 2025-04-25 1PM EDT; ~800GB of content pruned

cited.name: Wallpapers/Anime
cited.note: per moot's Something Awful post, 2003-10-02 02:43 GMT (= Oct 1 10:43PM EDT, timezone confirmed from viewing account settings): '/w/ - Wallpapers is also live now!' Posted 11 minutes after the TEST news post (Oct 1 10:32PM EDT), during mainpage setup — /w/ was live on the site's first day, before /c/ /d/ /y/ and possibly before /h/. Never announced on the news page; wiki's 10-06 batch date is wrong. Corroborated by BANNERS news post referencing 'three links' (image boards) when only /b/ and /h/ were announced
